|translation='''Title:''' Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder.

'''Card text:'''
USED: Cancel Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, or I Know. LOST: Use when Han and Leia are in a battle together. Draw two destiny. Subtract the total from opponent's attrition and total power. The values cannot fall below zero.

'''Lore:'''
But you didn't see us alone in the south passage. She told me her true feelings. Wha... you stuck-up, inconsiderate, scruffy-looking nerf herder!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' USED names 「孤独なハン」, 「戦士の勇気」, and 「知ってるさ」 for Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, and I Know.
